signals.why_it_matters: Aggregates 50,000 residential batteries into a 200 MW decentralized Virtual Power Plant.

signals.title: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy MOTIE South Korea Enforces Special Act on Distributed Energy Promotion
signals.summary: South Korea designated Distributed Energy Special Zones in Jeju and Busan, authorizing direct power sales between distributed solar-wind microgrid operators and local industrial consumers.
signals.why_it_matters: Authorizes direct peer-to-peer power sales in special distributed clean energy zones.

signals.title: Ministry of Economic Affairs MOEA Taiwan Implements Mandatory Rooftop Solar Installation on Large Public and Commercial Buildings
signals.summary: Taiwan enacted amendments to the Renewable Energy Development Act, requiring all newly constructed buildings with roof areas exceeding 1,000 square meters to install solar PV panels.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates solar panels on all new public and commercial buildings over 1,000 square meters.

signals.title: National Energy Regulator of South Africa NERSA Licenses Municipal Embedded Generation and Wheeling in Cape Town
signals.source_name: NERSA & City of Cape Town (South Africa)
signals.summary: Cape Town operationalized third-party electricity wheeling across the municipal grid, allowing commercial solar farms to sell clean power directly to downtown office towers and tech hubs.
signals.why_it_matters: Authorizes clean power wheeling across municipal grids, ending state utility monopolies.

signals.title: National Electric Energy Agency ANEEL Brazil Celebrates 30 Gigawatts of Distributed Solar Generation Micro e Minigeração Distribuída
signals.summary: Brazil surpassed 30 GW of installed distributed solar capacity across 2.5 million residential, commercial, and agro-industrial rooftop installations, powered by Marco Legal da Microgeração.
signals.why_it_matters: Surpasses 30 GW of decentralized rooftop solar across 2.5 million Brazilian properties.

signals.title: International Renewable Energy Agency IRENA and Global Renewables Alliance Launch Global Community Power Initiative
signals.summary: IRENA synthesized international policy evidence proving that citizen ownership and energy communities are essential to overcoming local permitting bottlenecks and achieving the global 3x renewables target.
signals.why_it_matters: Demonstrates citizen energy ownership is vital to tripling global renewable energy by 2030.

signals.title: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero DESNZ UK Closes Ratcliffe-on-Soar Ending 142 Years of Coal-Fired Electricity
signals.summary: The United Kingdom became the first G7 economy to achieve a 100% complete phaseout of coal-fired electricity generation, decommissioning its last operational coal plant at Ratcliffe-on-Soar.
signals.why_it_matters: Makes the UK the first G7 nation to completely eliminate coal-fired electricity generation.

signals.title: German Federal Network Agency Bundesnetzagentur Decommissions 15 Coal-Fired Power Plant Units Following Coal Phase-Out Act
signals.summary: Germany permanently disconnected 15 hard coal and lignite power plant units totaling 4.4 GW from the federal grid, accelerating decarbonization under the statutory Coal Phase-out Act.
signals.why_it_matters: Permanently shuts down 4.4 GW of coal power units under the German statutory phaseout law.

signals.title: French Ministry of Energy Transition Enforces Total Phase-Out of Last Two Coal Plants by 2027
signals.summary: France finalized binding conversion contracts for its last two coal units (Cordemais and Saint-Avold), transitioning them to green biomass pellets and thermal energy storage by 2027.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates complete conversion of final domestic coal units to biomass and thermal storage.

signals.title: Italian Ministry of Environment and Energy Security MASE Enforces Coal Exit Deadline of 2025 for Mainland Italy
signals.summary: Italy confirmed that all coal-fired electricity generation in mainland Italy will permanently shut down by December 2025, replaced by utility-scale batteries, solar, and offshore wind.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces permanent statutory closure of all mainland coal power plants by December 2025.

signals.title: Spanish Ministry for Ecological Transition MITECO Closes As Pontes Completing Spain's 90% Coal Phaseout
signals.summary: Spain completed the closure of As Pontes (1.4 GW)—once the largest coal power plant on the Iberian peninsula—redeploying the site for green hydrogen electrolysis and 1 GW of wind power.
signals.why_it_matters: Closes the Iberian peninsula's largest coal plant to construct green hydrogen and wind farms.

signals.title: EDP and Government of Portugal Celebrate Three Years of Zero Coal-Fired Power in National Grid
signals.source_name: Ministry of Environment and Energy (Portuguese Republic)
signals.summary: Portugal celebrated three continuous years of operating a completely coal-free power grid, generating over 70% of total national electricity from hydro, wind, and solar in 2024.
signals.why_it_matters: Maintains three years of 100% coal-free electricity with over 70% renewable generation.

signals.title: Verbund and Climate Ministry Austria Celebrate Four Years of 100% Coal-Free Electricity
signals.summary: Austria reported zero fossil coal usage in domestic power generation since shutting down Mellach in 2020, achieving 85% renewable share across national electricity consumption.
signals.why_it_matters: Achieves four consecutive years of zero coal power and 85% domestic renewable electricity.

signals.title: Federal Public Service Economy Belgium Marks Eight Years Since Total National Coal Exit
signals.summary: Belgium celebrated eight years as a coal-free power system, expanding Princess Elisabeth Island—the world's first artificial offshore energy island connecting 3.5 GW of North Sea wind.
signals.why_it_matters: Constructs the world's first artificial energy island to connect 3.5 GW of North Sea wind.

signals.title: Vattenfall and Swedish Government Celebrate Four Years of Completely Coal-Free Power Grid
signals.summary: Sweden maintained a 98% fossil-free electricity grid (hydro, nuclear, wind), shutting down all coal power plants and directing capital toward fossil-free steel manufacturing (HYBRIT).
signals.why_it_matters: Maintains a 98% fossil-free electricity grid powering green industrial steel mills.

signals.title: Finnish Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment Enforces Statutory Coal Ban Under Climate Act
signals.source_name: Ministry of Economic Affairs and Employment (Finland)
signals.summary: Finland surpassed its statutory 2029 coal ban five years ahead of schedule, with municipal district heating companies (Helen, Vantaan Energia) replacing coal with geothermal and waste-heat recovery.
signals.why_it_matters: Eliminates coal five years ahead of statutory schedule through deep geothermal district heat.

signals.title: Government of Canada Enforces Clean Electricity Regulations and Accelerated 2030 Coal Phaseout
signals.summary: Canada finalized regulations prohibiting unabated coal-fired electricity generation after 2030 and mandating net-zero electricity grids nationwide by 2035.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates a statutory deadline of 2030 to end unabated coal-fired power across Canada.

signals.title: Australian Energy Market Operator AEMO 2024 Integrated System Plan ISP Forecasts 90% Coal Exit by 2035
signals.summary: AEMO's statutory 20-year roadmap confirmed that 90% of Australia's remaining coal fleet will retire by 2035, requiring 10,000 km of new high-voltage transmission lines to connect clean energy.
signals.why_it_matters: Forecasts the retirement of 90% of Australia's coal fleet within a decade.

signals.title: United States Environmental Protection Agency EPA Enforces Final Carbon Pollution Standards for Power Plants
signals.summary: The EPA finalized Clean Air Act Section 111 rules requiring coal-fired power plants intending to operate past 2039 to capture 90% of their carbon dioxide emissions by 2032.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces 90% carbon capture requirements on long-running US fossil power plants.

signals.title: Presidency of South Africa Just Energy Transition Investment Plan JET-IP Commits R1.5 Trillion Funding
signals.source_name: Presidential Climate Commission (Republic of South Africa)
signals.summary: South Africa deployed the first tranche of $11 billion in international climate financing, decommissioning Komati coal power station and building agrivoltaic training academies in Mpumalanga.
signals.why_it_matters: Decommissions historical coal plants and opens agrivoltaic worker training centers.

signals.title: PT PLN and Asian Development Bank Finalize Early Retirement of Cirebon-1 660 MW Coal Power Plant under Energy Transition Mechanism ETM
signals.source_name: Asian Development Bank & PT PLN (Persero, Indonesia)
signals.summary: Indonesia and the ADB executed financial close to shorten Cirebon-1's operational life by seven years, eliminating 16 million tons of greenhouse gas emissions under the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP).
signals.why_it_matters: Executes early financial retirement of a 660 MW Indonesian coal plant under JETP.

signals.title: Government of Vietnam Enforces National Power Development Plan VIII PDP8 and Coal Capacity Caps
signals.source_name: Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT, Socialist Republic of Vietnam)
signals.summary: Vietnam enacted the Resource Mobilization Plan for its $15.5 billion JETP, halting 13,000 MW of planned coal-fired power plants and prioritizing offshore wind and battery storage.
signals.why_it_matters: Cancels 13 GW of planned coal power plants under Vietnam's $15.5 billion JETP pact.

signals.title: Department of Energy Philippines Enforces Moratorium on New Coal-Fired Power Plants and Renewable Portfolio Standards
signals.source_name: Department of Energy (Republic of the Philippines)
signals.summary: The Philippines rejected 10 GW of proposed coal projects under its statutory moratorium, mandating that power distribution utilities source at least 2.5% more renewable energy annually.
signals.why_it_matters: Blocks 10 GW of proposed coal power plants under a statutory national moratorium.

signals.title: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy MOTIE South Korea Mandates Closure of 30 Old Coal Plants by 2036
signals.source_name: MOTIE (11th Basic Plan for Long-Term Electricity Supply and Demand)
signals.summary: South Korea finalized plans to permanently shut down 30 operational coal-fired units (15 GW) by 2036, replacing them with pumped hydro storage and gigawatt-scale offshore wind farms.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates the permanent closure of 30 domestic coal power plants by 2036 in South Korea.

signals.title: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry METI Japan Formulates Fading Out of Inefficient Coal-Fired Power Plants by 2030
signals.summary: Japan finalized regulatory efficiency standards that will force the retirement or mothballing of 100 inefficient supercritical and subcritical coal units across Japanese utility grids by 2030.
signals.why_it_matters: Forces the retirement of 100 inefficient domestic coal-fired power plants by 2030.

signals.title: Powering Past Coal Alliance PPCA Crosses 180 Sovereign and Subnational Member Milestone
signals.source_name: Powering Past Coal Alliance (PPCA / UK & Canada Co-Chairs)
signals.summary: The global alliance of 60 national governments, 50 regional authorities, and 70 financial institutions reported that 75% of coal power capacity across OECD nations is now slated for retirement before 2030.
signals.why_it_matters: Tracks 75% of OECD coal capacity committed to complete retirement by 2030.

signals.title: European Parliament and Council Finalize Hydrogen and Decarbonised Gas Market Package
signals.source_name: European Parliament & Council of the European Union
signals.summary: The EU established a dedicated legal and regulatory framework for hydrogen networks (Directive EU 2024/1788), unbundling hydrogen transmission operators and mandating consumer third-party access.
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes the world's first comprehensive statutory regulatory market for green hydrogen grids.

signals.title: European Hydrogen Bank Awards €720 Million in First Renewable Hydrogen Auction
signals.summary: The EU allocated €720 million to seven green hydrogen projects across Spain, Portugal, Norway, and Finland, providing a 10-year fixed subsidy premium of €0.37 to €0.48 per kg of certified green hydrogen.
signals.why_it_matters: Awards €720 million in fixed 10-year production subsidies for certified green hydrogen.

signals.title: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs BMWK Approves €19 Billion Green Hydrogen Core Network Wasserstoff-Kernnetz
signals.summary: Germany approved the construction of a 9,700-kilometer nationwide hydrogen pipeline grid by 2032, converting 60% of existing natural gas pipelines to transport 100% green hydrogen to steel and chemical hubs.
signals.why_it_matters: Approves a 9,700 km nationwide hydrogen pipeline network repurposing existing gas pipes.

signals.title: German Federal Ministry for Housing, Urban Development and Building Enforces Building Energy Act Gebäudeenergiegesetz GEG
signals.summary: Germany enforced statutory rules requiring that all newly installed heating systems in new buildings must be powered by at least 65% renewable energy (such as heat pumps or district heating).
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates that all new heating installations derive at least 65% of energy from renewables.

signals.title: Danish Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities Approves 1 GW Power-to-X Green Hydrogen Pipeline to Germany
signals.source_name: Ministry of Climate, Energy and Utilities (Denmark)
signals.summary: Denmark and Germany finalized a binding intergovernmental treaty to construct the Jylland-Germany hydrogen interconnector, transporting 1 GW of offshore wind-derived green hydrogen by 2028.
signals.why_it_matters: Signs an intergovernmental treaty connecting Danish offshore wind hydrogen to German industry.

signals.title: Dutch Ministry of Economic Affairs EZK Allocates €1 Billion for Electrolyzer Scale-Up and Salt Cavern Hydrogen Storage
signals.summary: The Netherlands funded four underground salt cavern hydrogen storage caverns in Zuidwending, creating 1 terawatt-hour of strategic seasonal energy storage for North Sea wind power.
signals.why_it_matters: Constructs 1 TWh of seasonal green hydrogen storage in underground salt caverns.

signals.title: French Ministry of Ecological Transition Enforces Total Ban on Gas Boilers in New Buildings Under RE2020
signals.summary: France reported that RE2020 building regulations eliminated gas boilers from 95% of new single-family homes, replacing them with air-to-water heat pumps and geothermal loops.
signals.why_it_matters: Eliminates fossil gas boilers from 95% of new French residential construction.

signals.title: Federal Ministry for Climate Action Austria Enforces Renewable Heating Act Erneuerbare-Wärme-Gesetz EWG
signals.summary: Austria enacted the EWG, banning oil and coal heating installations in all buildings and offering up to 100% subsidies (Raus aus Öl und Gas) for low-income households switching to heat pumps.
signals.why_it_matters: Provides up to 100% state subsidies for low-income families replacing oil heaters with heat pumps.

signals.title: Italian Energy Storage Alliance and Terna Launch Fast Reserve Battery Storage Capacity Auctions
signals.summary: Italy auctioned 4 GW of utility-scale battery energy storage systems (MACSE mechanism) to support southern Italian solar grid integration, providing millisecond-level frequency stabilization.
signals.why_it_matters: Auctions 4 GW of utility-scale battery storage to eliminate southern solar curtailment.

signals.title: Spanish Ministry for Ecological Transition MITECO Approves Strategic Subsidies for Long-Duration Pumped Storage Hydro
signals.summary: Spain awarded €100 million to expand reversible pumped storage hydropower facilities in Galicia and Andalusia, adding 15 GWh of long-duration clean energy storage.
signals.why_it_matters: Adds 15 GWh of reversible pumped hydro long-duration energy storage capacity.

signals.title: UK Ofgem and DESNZ Enforce Clean Heat Market Mechanism CHMM for Heat Pump Manufacturing
signals.summary: The UK mandated that fossil boiler manufacturers must ensure that clean heat pumps constitute at least 4% of their total heating appliance sales, rising annually to reach 600,000 installs by 2028.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates that heating appliance manufacturers meet statutory heat pump sales quotas.

signals.title: United States Department of Energy DOE Announces $7 Billion Regional Clean Hydrogen Hubs H2Hubs Program Execution
signals.source_name: DOE Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations (OCED)
signals.summary: The US DOE began formal grant negotiations for seven regional hydrogen hubs (including ARCHES California and PNW Hydrogen Hub) to decarbonize heavy trucking, maritime ports, and steel mills.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys $7 billion across seven regional clean hydrogen demonstration hubs in the US.

signals.title: State of California Public Utilities Commission CPUC Mandates 15 Gigawatts of Long-Duration Energy Storage LDES
signals.summary: CPUC ordered California electric utilities to procure 15 GW of 8-hour to 100-hour long-duration energy storage (compressed air, flow batteries, thermal storage) by 2035 to replace gas peaker plants.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates 15 GW of long-duration energy storage to permanently retire natural gas peaker plants.

signals.title: State of New York Energy Research and Development Authority NYSERDA Awards World's Largest Thermal Energy Network TENs Grants
signals.summary: New York funded 13 utility-scale thermal energy networks connecting college campuses and public hospitals to sewer-heat recovery and geothermal heat exchangers under the Utility Thermal Energy Network Act.
signals.why_it_matters: Constructs 13 utility geothermal thermal networks recovering heat from municipal sewers.

signals.title: Australian Renewable Energy Agency ARENA Funds World's Largest Renewable Hydrogen Iron Ore Processing Pilots
signals.summary: ARENA funded 100 MW green hydrogen electrolysis plants in the Pilbara, directly testing the direct reduction of iron (DRI) with hydrogen to replace coking coal in global steel supply chains.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys 100 MW green hydrogen pilot to replace coking coal in iron ore reduction.

signals.title: Ministry of Energy Chile Enforces National Green Hydrogen Action Plan 2023-2030 in Magallanes and Antofagasta
signals.summary: Chile finalized spatial and environmental regulations to install 25 GW of wind-powered electrolysis in Patagonia, aiming to produce the world's lowest-cost green ammonia for international maritime export.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys 25 GW of Patagonian wind electrolysis for low-cost green ammonia export.

signals.title: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry METI Japan Enforces Hydrogen Society Promotion Act Suiso Shakai Suishin Hou
signals.summary: Japan enacted the Hydrogen Society Promotion Act, providing ¥3 trillion ($20 billion) over 15 years in Contract for Difference (CfD) subsidies bridging the cost gap between green hydrogen and fossil fuels.
signals.why_it_matters: Allocates $20 billion in 15-year Contracts for Difference bridging green hydrogen costs.

signals.title: Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy MOTIE South Korea Launches World's First Clean Hydrogen Power Generation Bidding Market CHPS
signals.summary: South Korea opened the world's first statutory bidding auction exclusively for electricity generated from certified clean hydrogen and ammonia (under 4 kg CO2e/kg H2), procuring 6,500 GWh annually.
signals.why_it_matters: Opens the world's first statutory bidding market for certified clean hydrogen power.

signals.title: International Energy Agency IEA Releases Global EV Outlook 2024 Documenting Electric Mobility Transformation
signals.summary: The IEA reported that electric cars accounted for 18% of all global car sales in 2023 and are projected to reach 45% by 2030, reducing global oil demand by 6 million barrels daily.
signals.why_it_matters: Documents that electric vehicles will displace 6 million barrels of oil demand daily by 2030.

signals.title: State of California Department of Water Resources DWR Enforces Sustainable Groundwater Management Act SGMA Basin Determinations
signals.source_name: California DWR & State Water Resources Control Board
signals.summary: California placed the Tulare Lake subbasin on probationary status, mandating that industrial agribusinesses meter all agricultural groundwater wells and pay $20 per acre-foot extraction fees.
signals.why_it_matters: Places overdrawn Central Valley aquifers on state probation to halt catastrophic subsidence.

signals.title: State of Arizona Department of Water Resources ADWR Limits New Suburban Housing Construction Over Phoenix Groundwater Depletion
signals.summary: Arizona halted residential subdivision approvals in the Phoenix Active Management Area that cannot prove a 100-year assured groundwater supply without relying on over-allocated aquifers.
signals.why_it_matters: Freezes suburban housing sprawl in desert basins lacking 100-year assured groundwater.

signals.title: French Ministry of Ecological Transition Enforces National Plan for Water Management Plan Eau and Aquifer Recharge
signals.summary: France invested €500 million in circular managed aquifer recharge (MAR) and treated wastewater reuse projects, setting a statutory target to cut national water abstraction by 10% by 2030.
signals.why_it_matters: Invests €500 million in managed aquifer recharge to cut national water withdrawal by 10%.

signals.title: Italian National Institute for Environmental Protection ISPRA Reports on Po River Valley Aquifer Vulnerability and Managed Recharge
signals.summary: Italy launched 20 artificial aquifer recharge pilots along the Po River basin, diverting winter alpine floodwaters into gravel paleochannels to recharge depleted groundwater reservoirs for summer droughts.
signals.why_it_matters: Diverts winter alpine floodwaters into underground paleochannels to recharge regional aquifers.

signals.title: German Federal Ministry for the Environment BMUV Enforces National Water Strategy Nationale Wasserstrategie and Regional Extraction Hierarchies
signals.summary: Germany enacted priority usage hierarchies under the Federal Water Act, guaranteeing that drinking water and ecological stream flows take legal precedence over industrial and agricultural extraction during heatwaves.
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes statutory legal priority for drinking water over industrial extraction during drought.

signals.title: Dutch Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management IenW Enforces Water and Soil Steering Principle Water en Bodem Sturend
signals.source_name: Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management (IenW, Netherlands)
signals.summary: The Netherlands mandated that spatial planning and agriculture must adapt to local groundwater levels rather than artificially pumping water away, raising water tables in peatlands to stop soil oxidation.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates that urban zoning and agriculture conform to natural groundwater tables.

signals.title: General Directorate of Water DGA Chile Enforces Reformed Water Code Código de Aguas Prioritizing Human Consumption
signals.source_name: DGA (Ministry of Public Works, Republic of Chile)
signals.summary: Chile constituted 50 statutory Groundwater User Communities (CAS) in hyper-arid northern valleys, installing real-time telemetry on private wells and capping avocado orchard withdrawals.
signals.why_it_matters: Installs real-time satellite telemetry on private wells to stop agricultural water hoarding.

signals.title: National Water Commission CONAGUA Mexico Declares Groundwater Protection Zones in Valley of Mexico and Bajío
signals.summary: Mexico issued strict extraction bans across 100 critically overexploited aquifers, prohibiting new industrial and beverage bottling concessions to prevent urban land sinking.
signals.why_it_matters: Bans new commercial water extraction across 100 critically sinking urban aquifers in Mexico.

signals.title: Central Ground Water Authority CGWA India Enforces Mandatory Digital Telemetry on Commercial Borewells
signals.source_name: CGWA (Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India)
signals.summary: India required 50,000 industrial and commercial facilities extracting groundwater in critical assessment units to install IoT-connected tamper-proof digital flowmeters transmitting hourly data.
signals.why_it_matters: Requires 50,000 industrial borewells to stream live IoT extraction data to the national water portal.

signals.title: State of Maharashtra Celebrates 10 Years of Jalyukt Shivar Abhiyan Decentralized Watershed Harvesting
signals.source_name: Department of Water Conservation (Government of Maharashtra, India)
signals.summary: Maharashtra constructed 500,000 decentralized check dams, farm ponds, and percolation tanks across drought-prone Marathwada, raising local groundwater tables by 2 meters in 5,000 agrarian villages.
signals.why_it_matters: Raises village water tables by 2 meters across 5,000 drought-prone Indian farming communities.

signals.title: Punjab Irrigation Department Pakistan Enforces Punjab Groundwater Protection and Regulation Act
signals.source_name: Punjab Irrigation Department (Government of the Punjab, Pakistan)
signals.summary: Pakistan licensed 200,000 tube wells across the Indus Basin aquifer, establishing critical depletion zones where unregulated solar-powered tube well drilling is legally prohibited.
signals.why_it_matters: Prohibits unregulated tube well drilling in depleted agricultural zones across the Indus Basin.

signals.title: Ministry of Water Resources MWR China Reports Rebound of Groundwater Levels in North China Plain After South-to-North Water Diversion
signals.source_name: Ministry of Water Resources (People's Republic of China)
signals.summary: China reported that shallow and deep groundwater levels across Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei rose by an average of 3.5 meters following massive managed river water replenishment and strict well closures.
signals.why_it_matters: Restores North China Plain water tables by 3.5 meters through ecological aquifer recharge.

signals.title: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture MEWA Saudi Arabia Phases Out Water-Intensive Forage Crop Cultivation
signals.summary: Saudi Arabia finalized the statutory phase-out of domestic green fodder (alfalfa) production on commercial mega-farms, saving 8 billion cubic meters of non-renewable fossil groundwater annually.
signals.why_it_matters: Saves 8 billion cubic meters of ancient fossil groundwater by banning commercial alfalfa farming.

signals.title: Ministry of Water and Irrigation Jordan Enforces Real-Time Groundwater Telemetry in Azraq and Disi Aquifers
signals.source_name: Ministry of Water and Irrigation (Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan)
signals.summary: Jordan sealed 1,500 illegal agricultural wells and installed smart volumetric meters across the Azraq basin, safeguarding fragile desert spring oases from irreversible salinization.
signals.why_it_matters: Seals 1,500 illegal desert borewells to protect historic Ramsar oasis aquifers.

signals.title: Murray-Darling Basin Authority MDBA Enforces Sustainable Diversion Limits SDL Compliance and Metering Standards
signals.summary: The MDBA enforced statutory SDL caps across the 1 million sq km basin, fining corporate cotton irrigators for exceeding floodplain harvesting limits and restoring flows to Murray mouth wetlands.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces statutory extraction caps across 1 million square kilometers of the Murray-Darling basin.

signals.title: UNESCO Intergovernmental Hydrological Programme UNESCO-IHP Launches Global Groundwater Sustainability Assessment
signals.summary: UNESCO mapped 400 shared transboundary aquifers globally, calling for international treaties to regulate deep fossil groundwater extraction that threatens irreversible intergenerational water depletion.
signals.why_it_matters: Maps 400 transboundary aquifers globally to prevent irreversible fossil water depletion.

signals.title: United Nations Economic Commission for Europe UNECE Marks 32 Years of the UN Water Convention 1992-2024
signals.source_name: UNECE (Convention on the Protection and Use of Transboundary Watercourses)
signals.summary: Ivory Coast, Sierra Leone, and Zambia acceded to the 1992 UN Water Convention, expanding the global legal architecture for peaceful equitable transboundary river basin management.
signals.why_it_matters: Expands the global UN Water Convention legal treaty to 55 sovereign cross-border river nations.

signals.title: Mekong River Commission MRC Convenes Summit Adopting Basin Development Strategy 2021-2030 and Flow Thresholds
signals.source_name: Mekong River Commission (Cambodia, Laos, Thailand, Vietnam)
signals.summary: MRC countries established live telemetry data-sharing protocols for upstream mainstream hydropower dams, protecting fish migration and Tonle Sap reverse-flow hydrological dynamics.
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes real-time hydropower dam telemetry sharing across the entire Mekong River basin.

signals.title: International Commission for the Protection of the Rhine ICPR Celebrates 74 Years of Rhine Water Quality Restoration
signals.source_name: ICPR (Switzerland, France, Germany, Luxembourg, Netherlands, EU)
signals.summary: The ICPR reported that chemical micropollutant discharges into the Rhine dropped by 30% under the 'Rhine 2040' program, restoring Atlantic salmon spawning grounds up to Basel.
signals.why_it_matters: Restores Atlantic salmon spawning grounds up to Switzerland via cross-border chemical cleanup.

signals.title: International Commission for the Protection of the Danube River ICPDR Finalizes Danube River Basin Management Plan
signals.source_name: ICPDR (14 Danube Basin Sovereign States & EU)
signals.summary: The 14-nation commission approved fish migration bypass channels around the Iron Gate dams, allowing endangered Beluga sturgeon to migrate upstream across 1,000 kilometers of the Danube.
signals.why_it_matters: Constructs cross-border fish passes around mega-dams to save Danube giant sturgeon.

signals.title: Nile Basin Initiative NBI Convenes Extraordinary Council of Ministers on Cooperative Framework Agreement CFA
signals.summary: The historic Nile Basin Cooperative Framework Agreement (CFA) secured its sixth state ratification (South Sudan), establishing the permanent Nile River Basin Commission to oversee equitable water sharing.
signals.why_it_matters: Brings the historic Nile Basin Cooperative Framework Agreement into permanent international force.

signals.title: Lake Chad Basin Commission LCBC Enforces Climate Resilience and Ecosystem Restoration Charter
signals.summary: The five-nation commission rehabilitated 50,000 hectares of degraded lakeshore wetlands and dredged the Chari and Logone riverbeds to restore seasonal flood irrigation for pastoralists.
signals.why_it_matters: Restores 50,000 hectares of transboundary wetland floodplains across the Lake Chad Basin.

signals.title: Permanent Okavango River Basin Water Commission OKACOM Enforces Strategic Environmental Assessment for Delta Protection
signals.summary: Angola, Namibia, and Botswana enacted harmonized environmental flow guidelines, prohibiting upstream irrigation abstractions that would threaten seasonal flooding of the Okavango Delta.
signals.why_it_matters: Enacts binding transboundary water extraction caps to preserve the pristine Okavango Delta.

signals.title: Zambezi Watercourse Commission ZAMCOM Operates Zambezi Strategic Plan and Flood Forecasting System
signals.summary: ZAMCOM deployed a satellite-linked hydrodynamic early warning model across the 1.4 million sq km basin, coordinating reservoir releases between Kariba and Cahora Bassa dams.
signals.why_it_matters: Coordinates multi-dam transboundary water releases across eight Southern African nations.

signals.title: Amazon Cooperation Treaty Organization ACTO OTCA Launches Amazon Basin Water Resources Monitoring Network
signals.summary: The eight Amazonian nations inaugurated the Amazonian Water Observatory (AWO), sharing real-time water quality, sediment load, and drought metrics across 7 million sq km of river networks.
signals.why_it_matters: Inaugurates real-time water observatory sharing telemetry across 7 million sq km of the Amazon.

signals.title: City of Paris Eau de Paris Celebrates 14 Years of Successful Public Water Re-Municipalization
signals.summary: Eau de Paris reported that municipal public management maintained water tariffs 25% below the national private average, funded 100% organic farm conversion in water catchments, and installed 1,200 free public drinking fountains.
signals.why_it_matters: Maintains public water tariffs 25% below private concessions while funding organic catchment farming.

signals.title: Metropolis of Lyon Métropole de Lyon Operates Eau Publique du Grand Lyon Following Private Contract Exit
signals.summary: Lyon completed its first full year of 100% publicly managed water services, introducing a progressive social water tariff guaranteeing the first 12 cubic meters of water free for low-income households.
signals.why_it_matters: Guarantees the first 12 cubic meters of household water free under progressive public tariffs.

signals.title: Terrassa Public Water Utility Taigua Celebrates Five Years of Public Municipal Water Management in Catalonia
signals.summary: The Catalan municipality of 220,000 residents invested €10 million in pipe leak reduction and universal water access funds following the termination of a 75-year private corporate concession.
signals.why_it_matters: Invests municipal operating surpluses into pipe leak reduction after terminating 75-year concession.

signals.title: Berliner Wasserbetriebe BWB Germany Operates Europe's Largest Municipal Water and Wastewater Utility
signals.summary: Berlin celebrated 10 years since re-municipalizing its water services, operating closed-loop river-bank filtration water treatment without chlorine and reinvesting all profits into climate-resilient infrastructure.
signals.why_it_matters: Supplies chlorine-free tap water across Berlin while reinvesting 100% of profits into public infrastructure.

signals.title: High Court of Justice UK Places Water Companies Under Criminal Investigation for Unlawful Sewage Discharges
signals.source_name: High Court of Justice (Queen's Bench Division, UK)
signals.summary: The High Court upheld civil society legal challenges against regulatory inaction, ordering the Environment Agency to strictly enforce statutory prohibitions against illegal storm overflow dumping.
signals.why_it_matters: Orders statutory regulatory crackdowns on private water utilities dumping untreated sewage.

signals.title: City of Baltimore Department of Public Works Celebrates Six Years of Charter Amendment Banning Water Privatization
signals.summary: Baltimore reported on its historic 2018 municipal charter amendment—the first in a major US city—which permanently constitutionally banned the sale or lease of the municipal water and sewer system.
signals.why_it_matters: Maintains the first permanent municipal constitutional ban on water utility privatization in the US.

signals.title: Empresas Públicas de Medellín EPM Celebrates 69 Years of Municipal Multi-Utility Ownership and Social Tariffs
signals.summary: The municipally owned utility transferred $500 million in operating dividends to the city of Medellín, funding social housing, free student transit, and universal clean water for hillside informal communities.
signals.why_it_matters: Transfers $500 million in municipal utility profits to fund urban social services.

signals.title: National Administration of State Sanitary Works OSE Uruguay Celebrates 20 Years of Constitutional Human Right to Water
signals.summary: Uruguay commemorated 20 years since the historic 2004 plebiscite that made Uruguay the first nation in the world to enshrine the human right to water and ban private concessions in its national constitution.
signals.why_it_matters: Celebrates 20 years as the world's first constitution explicitly banning water utility privatization.

signals.title: Transnational Institute TNI and Public Services International PSI Publish Global Re-Municipalization Database Update
signals.summary: TNI documented over 350 cities across 40 countries that have re-municipalized water and sanitation services over the past 15 years, proving public management delivers superior equity, transparency, and climate resilience.
signals.why_it_matters: Documents 350 global cities successfully taking water utilities back under public control.

signals.title: European Parliament and Council Enact Critical Raw Materials Act Regulation EU 2024/1252
signals.source_name: European Parliament & Council of the European Union
signals.summary: The EU established statutory benchmarks for 2030: at least 10% of strategic raw materials extracted in the EU, 40% processed domestically, and at least 25% sourced from recycled scrap.
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes binding European benchmarks for domestic critical mineral extraction and recycling.

signals.title: European Commission Finalizes Mandatory Battery Recycling Efficiency and Material Recovery Targets
signals.summary: Under the Battery Regulation, the EU mandated that recycling facilities must achieve 90% cobalt, copper, and nickel recovery and 50% lithium recovery by 2027, rising to 80% lithium by 2031.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates a statutory 80% lithium recovery rate in commercial EV battery recycling plants.

signals.title: United States Department of Energy DOE Expands Battery Materials Processing Grants with $3.5 Billion Allocation
signals.source_name: Office of Manufacturing and Energy Supply Chains (DOE, US)
signals.summary: The US DOE funded 14 advanced domestic battery component and recycling facilities under the Bipartisan Infrastructure Law, scaling domestic lithium iron phosphate (LFP) and cathode production.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys $3.5 billion to construct domestic battery recycling and cathode manufacturing plants.

signals.title: Natural Resources Canada NRCan Enforces Critical Minerals Strategy and Value Chain Indigenous Partnerships
signals.summary: Canada allocated $1.5 billion from the Critical Minerals Infrastructure Fund, conditioning federal project financing on direct First Nations equity ownership in transmission and road access.
signals.why_it_matters: Conditions federal mining infrastructure grants on direct First Nations equity ownership.

signals.title: Australian Government DCCEEW Enforces Future Made in Australia Critical Minerals Production Tax Incentive
signals.source_name: Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet (Australia)
signals.summary: Australia enacted a 10% production tax credit for processing and refining 31 critical minerals domestically, incentivizing downstream lithium hydroxide, nickel sulfate, and rare earth refining.
signals.why_it_matters: Enacts a 10% production tax credit for downstream domestic critical mineral refining.

signals.title: National Lithium Corporation of Chile ENAMI and Codelco Enforce National Lithium Strategy Estrategia Nacional del Litio
signals.source_name: Ministry of Mining & Codelco (Republic of Chile)
signals.summary: Chile finalized state-majority joint ventures in Salar de Atacama and Maricunga, mandating Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) technologies that re-inject 95% of brine to protect desert aquifers.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates Direct Lithium Extraction (DLE) to re-inject 95% of brine back into desert aquifers.

signals.title: Ministry of Mines and Energy MME Brazil Launches National Critical Minerals Policy and Green Mining Valley in Jequitinhonha
signals.summary: Brazil regulated the 'Lithium Valley' (Vale do Lítio) in Minas Gerais, enforcing dry-stack tailings, 100% water recirculation, and local community revenue-sharing trusts for lithium extraction.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces zero-liquid-discharge and dry-stack tailings in Brazilian green lithium mining.

signals.title: Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources MEMR Indonesia Enforces Downstream Nickel Smelter Traceability and Renewable Powering
signals.source_name: MEMR & Coordinating Ministry for Maritime and Investment Affairs (Indonesia)
signals.summary: Indonesia mandated that all new high-pressure acid leach (HPAL) nickel smelters in Morowali and Weda Bay must phase out on-site coal power and install dry-tailings waste disposal.
signals.why_it_matters: Forces nickel smelter complexes to phase out captive coal power in favor of renewables.

signals.title: International Council on Mining and Metals ICMM Enforces Global Standard on Tailings Management GISTM
signals.summary: ICMM certified that 1,200 large-scale mining operations completed independent audits under the Global Industry Standard on Tailings Management, preventing catastrophic dam collapses.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces independent engineering safety audits on 1,200 global mining tailings dams.

signals.title: H2 Green Steel Stegra Closes €6.5 Billion Project Financing for World's First Large-Scale Green Steel Plant in Boden
signals.summary: Construction progressed on Europe's premier commercial green steel plant in northern Sweden, utilizing 1 GW of green hydrogen electrolysis to reduce iron ore with 95% lower CO2 emissions than traditional blast furnaces.
signals.why_it_matters: Secures €6.5 billion to build the world's first 1 GW hydrogen-powered commercial green steel plant.

signals.title: German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs BMWK Awards €2.6 Billion Climate Protection Contracts Carbon Contracts for Difference CCfD
signals.summary: Germany pioneered the world's first statutory Carbon Contracts for Difference (Klimaschutzverträge), compensating steel, glass, and chemical giants for operating zero-emission industrial technologies.
signals.why_it_matters: Pioneers the world's first statutory Carbon Contracts for Difference for heavy industry.

signals.title: French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Industrial Sovereignty Awards €500 Million for Low-Carbon Cement Kiln Conversions
signals.summary: France funded calcined clay and oxyfuel combustion conversions at cement kilns in Normandy and Occitanie, slashing clinker ratios and capturing 80% of process CO2 emissions.
signals.why_it_matters: Subsidizes industrial calcined clay conversions cutting cement process emissions by 80%.

signals.title: United States Department of Energy DOE Awards $6 Billion for Industrial Demonstrations Program Across Steel, Aluminum and Cement
signals.source_name: Office of Clean Energy Demonstrations (DOE, US)
signals.summary: The US DOE funded 33 industrial decarbonization projects in 20 states, including the world's first zero-carbon aluminum smelting potline and hydrogen direct-reduced iron mills in Ohio and Mississippi.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys $6 billion to construct zero-carbon aluminum and green hydrogen steel mills.

signals.title: European Commission Approves €3.2 Billion State Aid for Thyssenkrupp and Salzgitter Direct Reduced Iron Plants
signals.summary: The EU approved state aid under the Green Deal Industrial Plan to convert traditional coal blast furnaces in Duisburg and Salzgitter into hydrogen-ready direct reduction iron (DRI) shafts.
signals.why_it_matters: Converts historical German coal blast furnaces into 100% hydrogen-ready direct reduction towers.

signals.title: First Movers Coalition FMC Reaches 100 Global Corporations Committing $16 Billion in Green Industrial Procurement
signals.source_name: World Economic Forum & US Special Presidential Envoy for Climate
signals.summary: Over 100 multinational corporations (Apple, Microsoft, Volvo, Maersk) committed to purchasing near-zero carbon steel, sustainable aviation fuel (SAF), and low-carbon concrete by 2030.
signals.why_it_matters: Mobilizes $16 billion in advance corporate purchasing commitments for green steel and cement.

signals.title: European Commission Directorate-General for Taxation and Customs Union DG TAXUD Enforces CBAM Transitional Phase Reporting
signals.summary: The EU processed quarterly embedded carbon emissions reports from 20,000 global importers of steel, aluminum, cement, fertilizers, and hydrogen under Regulation (EU) 2023/956.
signals.why_it_matters: Processes embedded carbon reporting across 20,000 industrial importers under EU CBAM.

signals.title: HM Treasury and Department for Energy Security and Net Zero Announce UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism for 2027
signals.summary: The UK launched statutory consultations on its domestic CBAM to apply from January 2027, placing a carbon price on imported industrial goods to mirror the UK Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS).
signals.why_it_matters: Enacts a UK Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism applying to imports starting January 2027.

signals.title: Department of Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water DCCEEW Reviews Australian Carbon Border Adjustment Feasibility
signals.summary: Australia released its Carbon Leakage Review, recommending the development of an Australian CBAM for trade-exposed steel and cement sectors while establishing mutual recognition with the EU.
signals.why_it_matters: Advances legislative design for an Australian Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism.

signals.title: United States Senate Advances Clean Competition Act and Foreign Pollution Fee Framework
signals.source_name: US Senate (Senator Sheldon Whitehouse / Senator Bill Cassidy)
signals.summary: Bipartisan US lawmakers advanced legislation to impose an ad valorem greenhouse gas tariff on imported energy-intensive primary goods (steel, petrochemicals, glass) based on foreign carbon intensity.
signals.why_it_matters: Advances bipartisan US federal legislation establishing carbon-intensity import tariffs.

signals.title: Ministry of Trade Republic of Turkey Accelerates National ETS and Green Deal Action Plan in Response to EU CBAM
signals.summary: Turkey drafted national legislation establishing a domestic Turkish Emissions Trading System (ETS), ensuring Turkish steel and aluminum exporters pay carbon fees domestically rather than at EU borders.
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes a national Turkish ETS to retain carbon revenue domestically under EU CBAM.

signals.title: World Trade Organization WTO Committee on Trade and Environment Convenes on Carbon Accounting and Trade Policy
signals.summary: The WTO convened trade ministers from 164 member states to debate harmonized global standards for embedded greenhouse gas accounting, preventing unilateral green trade protectionism.
signals.why_it_matters: Leads multilateral trade negotiations to harmonize global embedded carbon accounting.

signals.title: Department of Health and Human Services HHS Enforces Mental Health Parity and Addiction Equity Act MHPAEA Final Rules
signals.summary: The US federal government finalized rules requiring commercial health insurers to provide the same level of coverage for youth psychological therapy as medical/surgical benefits, eliminating prior authorization delays.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces statutory parity requiring commercial insurers to fully cover youth mental health.

signals.title: State of Illinois Enforces Public Act 102-0321 Mental Health Days for Public School Students
signals.source_name: Illinois State Board of Education (ISBE, US)
signals.summary: Illinois reported on its statutory policy granting public school students up to five excused absence mental health days per school year without requiring a physician's medical note.
signals.why_it_matters: Grants public school students up to five excused mental health absence days annually.

signals.title: Department for Education DfE UK Deploys Mental Health Support Teams MHSTs to 50% of English Schools
signals.summary: The UK expanded NHS-trained mental health teams to 4,000 schools and colleges, providing early clinical cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) directly on school grounds.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys clinical NHS mental health support teams directly into 4,000 English schools.

signals.title: Australian Government Department of Health and Aged Care Expands Headspace Youth Mental Health Centers Network
signals.source_name: Department of Health and Aged Care (Australia)
signals.summary: Australia funded 160 community-based Headspace youth centers, providing free, non-stigmatizing walk-in mental health, alcohol, and vocational support for young people aged 12 to 25.
signals.why_it_matters: Provides free walk-in mental health and counseling clinics across 160 youth centers in Australia.

signals.title: Government of Canada Launches Youth Mental Health Fund with $500 Million Investment
signals.source_name: Health Canada & Public Health Agency of Canada
signals.summary: Canada created a federal Youth Mental Health Fund to subsidize grassroots youth organizations, Indigenous wellness lodges, and 24/7 crisis text lines across all provinces.
signals.why_it_matters: Invests $500 million in community-led youth mental health clinics and indigenous lodges.

signals.title: Ministry of Health New Zealand Manatū Hauora Expands Mana Ake School Wellbeing Program
signals.source_name: Ministry of Health & Te Whatu Ora (Health New Zealand)
signals.summary: New Zealand expanded Mana Ake wellbeing workers into 1,000 primary and intermediate schools, supporting Māori and Pacific tamariki with culturally rooted emotional regulation programs.
signals.why_it_matters: Integrates culturally grounded mental wellbeing workers across 1,000 primary schools.

signals.title: French Ministry of Health and Prevention Expands MonSoutienPsy Free Psychological Sessions for Children and Teens
signals.source_name: Ministry of Labour, Health and Prevention (France)
signals.summary: France increased state reimbursements to 12 free psychologist sessions annually for children and youth aged 3 to 25, eliminating the requirement for prior general practitioner referral.
signals.why_it_matters: Provides 12 free psychologist consultations annually for youth through national healthcare.

signals.title: Swedish National Board of Health and Welfare Socialstyrelsen Evaluates First-Line Youth Mental Health Centers Ungas Psykiska Hälsa
signals.summary: Sweden expanded regional first-line youth clinics (Första linjen), guaranteeing clinical psychological evaluation within 14 days of parental or self-referral.
signals.why_it_matters: Guarantees clinical youth psychological consultations within a strict 14-day statutory limit.

signals.title: World Health Organization WHO Releases Comprehensive Mental Health Action Plan 2013-2030 Midterm Evaluation
signals.summary: WHO published global findings urging member states to integrate mental health services directly into universal primary healthcare and schools, highlighting the global youth mental crisis.
signals.why_it_matters: Urges global integration of youth psychological care directly into public primary schools.

signals.title: US Surgeon General Calls for Warning Labels on Social Media Platforms for Adolescent Mental Health
signals.source_name: Office of the Surgeon General (Dr. Vivek Murthy, US Public Health Service)
signals.summary: The US Surgeon General officially called on Congress to mandate tobacco-style warning labels on commercial social media apps, citing clinical evidence linking platforms to adolescent depression and body dysmorphia.
signals.why_it_matters: Calls for mandatory federal health warning labels on commercial social media platforms.

signals.title: State of Utah Enforces Utah Social Media Regulation Act Requiring Age Verification and Curfews
signals.summary: Utah enacted regulations requiring social media companies to verify user age, obtain parental consent for minors, and disable algorithmic recommendation feeds between 10:30 PM and 6:30 AM.
signals.why_it_matters: Imposes overnight algorithmic recommendation curfews on minors' social media accounts.

signals.title: State of New York Passes Stop Addictive Feeds Exploitation SAFE for Kids Act and Child Data Protection Act
signals.source_name: New York State Legislature (Signed by Governor Kathy Hochul)
signals.summary: New York banned tech platforms from providing addictive algorithmic feeds to minors without parental consent and prohibited platforms from sending midnight notifications to children.
signals.why_it_matters: Bans addictive algorithmic feeds and late-night push notifications for minors in NY.

signals.title: European Commission Opens Formal Proceedings Against Meta Under Digital Services Act DSA on Minor Protection
signals.summary: The EU investigated Facebook and Instagram algorithms for exploiting minors' behavioral vulnerabilities (rabbit hole effects) and failing to enforce age-assurance tools under the DSA.
signals.why_it_matters: Launches formal EU antitrust and safety investigations into addictive algorithmic feeds.

signals.title: UK Ofcom Publishes Draft Protection of Children Codes of Practice Under the Online Safety Act 2023
signals.summary: Ofcom mandated that online platforms must implement robust age estimation, disable direct messaging between adults and unrelated children, and turn off addictive autoplay by default for minors.
signals.why_it_matters: Disables autoplay and adult-to-child direct messaging by default across UK online platforms.

signals.title: Australian Government Commits to Legislating Minimum Age Limits for Social Media Access
signals.source_name: Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts (Australia)
signals.summary: Australia announced federal legislation to establish a statutory minimum age (between 14 and 16) for opening social media accounts, backed by trial age-assurance technology verification.
signals.why_it_matters: Prepares federal legislation imposing statutory minimum age limits on social media accounts.

signals.title: French National Assembly Enforces Law No 2023-566 on Digital Majority and Social Media Parental Consent
signals.summary: France implemented statutory rules requiring platforms to obtain explicit parental authorization before registering users under 15 years old (majorité numérique).
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes a statutory digital majority age of 15 requiring parental consent for younger teens.

signals.title: UNESCO Launches Guidelines for Regulating Digital Platforms and Protecting Youth from Algorithmic Manipulation
signals.summary: UNESCO published global regulatory benchmarks urging nations to mandate human rights impact assessments on recommender algorithms and ban dark commercial design patterns targeting children.
signals.why_it_matters: Publishes global regulatory benchmarks prohibiting dark commercial design patterns on children.

signals.title: Climate Psychology Alliance and Lancet Psychiatry Publish Clinical Guidelines for Climate-Related Distress
signals.source_name: The Lancet Psychiatry & Climate Psychology Alliance (London)
signals.summary: Psychiatric associations published clinical diagnostic frameworks for eco-anxiety, validating climate grief and distress as rational psychological responses requiring community resilience and civic agency rather than pathologization.
signals.why_it_matters: Validates eco-anxiety as a rational response to ecological destruction requiring civic empowerment.

signals.title: Canadian Medical Association CMA and Paediatric Society Adopt Nature Prescription Program PaRx Across All Provinces
signals.source_name: Canadian Paediatric Society & BC Parks Foundation
signals.summary: Canadian doctors issued 50,000 free statutory 'Nature Prescriptions' (PaRx) providing national and provincial park passes to children and teens experiencing depression and climate distress.
signals.why_it_matters: Issues 50,000 free medical 'Nature Prescriptions' granting park passes to combat youth anxiety.

signals.title: NHS England and Natural England Expand Green Social Prescribing to 50 Integrated Care Systems
signals.source_name: NHS England & Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
signals.summary: The NHS scaled green social prescribing for adolescents, referring 30,000 young people to community urban gardening, wetland restoration, and wilderness therapy with a 65% reduction in anxiety symptoms.
signals.why_it_matters: Refers 30,000 adolescents to green social prescribing nature therapies with 65% anxiety reduction.

signals.title: Australian Psychological Society APS Publishes Climate Change and Youth Mental Health Practice Guide
signals.summary: The APS provided 27,000 registered psychologists with therapeutic protocols connecting young people experiencing bushfire and climate trauma with direct ecological restoration projects.
signals.why_it_matters: Trains 27,000 registered psychologists in climate distress trauma therapies.

signals.title: Finnish Association for Mental Health MIELI Launches Eco-Emotions Youth Peer Support Network Ympäristötunteet
signals.source_name: MIELI Mental Health Finland & Ministry of Social Affairs and Health
signals.summary: Finland funded specialized digital peer-counseling spaces for youth struggling with Arctic warming and loss of snow cover, integrating Sámi cultural resilience practices.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys digital peer support counseling for Nordic youth mourning subarctic climate changes.

signals.title: American Psychological Association APA Releases Climate Change, Mental Health, and Youth Well-Being Policy Brief
signals.summary: The APA documented that 68% of American youth report chronic climate distress, urging school districts to replace disaster-fatalism curricula with hands-on school micro-farming and solar installation projects.
signals.why_it_matters: Urges US school districts to integrate climate action projects to alleviate youth despair.

signals.title: White House Launches American Climate Corps ACC Official Recruitment with 20,000 Paid Youth Members
signals.summary: The US opened applications for 20,000 paid federal positions across clean energy, wetland restoration, wildfire prevention, and energy efficiency, offering living wages and fast-track federal hiring.
signals.why_it_matters: Mobilizes 20,000 paid young Americans into the federal American Climate Corps.

signals.title: Government of Canada Launches Youth Climate Corps Initiative Under Budget 2024
signals.summary: Canada funded 15,000 green jobs and apprenticeships for young people under 30 in clean tech, ecological forestry, and municipal retrofits through the Youth Employment and Skills Strategy (YESS).
signals.why_it_matters: Funds 15,000 green jobs and clean tech apprenticeships for young Canadians.

signals.title: UK Department for Work and Pensions DWP Launches Green Apprenticeships Advisory Panel Framework
signals.source_name: Institute for Apprenticeships and Technical Education (IfATE, UK)
signals.summary: The UK approved 50 certified 'Green Apprenticeship' standards in offshore wind maintenance, heat pump installation, and retrofitting, guaranteeing free tuition and living wages for young apprentices.
signals.why_it_matters: Certifies 50 tuition-free Green Apprenticeships in offshore wind and building retrofits.

signals.title: Australian Government Department of Employment and Workplace Relations Launches New Energy Apprenticeships Scheme
signals.summary: Australia awarded AUD $10,000 direct completion bonuses and mentoring support to 10,000 clean energy apprentices training in solar PV installation, electrical engineering, and grid battery storage.
signals.why_it_matters: Provides $10,000 completion bonuses to 10,000 young Australian clean energy apprentices.

signals.title: German Federal Ministry of Education and Research BMBF Expands Dual Vocational Training for Green Occupations
signals.summary: Germany integrated standardized sustainability and decarbonization skills into all 330 certified dual vocational apprenticeship curricula (Duale Ausbildung), training 1.3 million youth apprentices.
signals.why_it_matters: Integrates mandatory green sustainability skills into all 330 German apprenticeship trades.

signals.title: French Ministry of Labour, Health and Solidarities Launches Green Skills Pact Plan Compétences Vertes
signals.summary: France allocated €1 billion from France 2030 to train 100,000 youth annually in high-demand ecological trades: electric vehicle maintenance, building insulation, and agroforestry.
signals.why_it_matters: Invests €1 billion to train 100,000 French youth annually in certified ecological trades.

signals.title: International Labour Organization ILO Publishes Global Employment Trends for Youth 2024 Green Transition Edition
signals.summary: The ILO documented that the global transition to net-zero energy and circular economy could generate 24 million net new jobs globally by 2030, calling for universal social protection for young green workers.
signals.why_it_matters: Forecasts 24 million net new green transition jobs globally by 2030.

signals.title: European Commission Directorate-General for Regional and Urban Policy Disburses €19.2 Billion Just Transition Fund JTF
signals.summary: The EU funded 96 territorial just transition plans across Silesia, Lusatia, and Asturias, funding worker reskilling, wage guarantees, and green manufacturing parks in retiring coal basins.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys €19.2 billion across 96 European coal regions to guarantee worker retraining.

signals.title: Institute for Just Transition ITJ Spain Celebrates Five Years of Just Transition Agreements Convenios de Transición Justa
signals.summary: Spain achieved 100% union-backed agreements across all closed coal and nuclear basins, providing early retirement at age 52 with 80% pension guarantees and hiring preference for young workers.
signals.why_it_matters: Guarantees 80% pensions at age 52 for retired miners and green hiring quotas for youth.

signals.title: German Federal Government Reports on Structural Development Act for Mining Regions Investitionsgesetz Kohleregionen InvKG
signals.summary: Germany invested €40 billion across the Rhenish, Lusatian, and Central German lignite mining areas, constructing railway links, battery research institutes, and university research campuses.
signals.why_it_matters: Directs €40 billion to transform historical German open-pit coal basins into science hubs.

signals.title: Interagency Working Group on Coal and Power Plant Communities Delivers $500 Million in Federal Targeted Grants
signals.source_name: White House Energy Communities IWG & Appalachian Regional Commission
signals.summary: The US targeted funding to coalfield towns in West Virginia and Wyoming, constructing solar panel manufacturing plants and data centers on reclaimed former strip mines.
signals.why_it_matters: Constructs solar manufacturing and data centers on reclaimed Appalachian strip mines.

signals.title: Marshal's Office of the Silesian Voivodeship Urząd Marszałkowski Województwa Śląskiego Deploys €2.2 Billion Just Transition Funds
signals.summary: Silesia—the EU's largest coal mining region—trained 25,000 underground coal miners in heat pump manufacturing and electric bus assembly with full wage replacement during training.
signals.why_it_matters: Trains 25,000 Polish coal miners in clean transport manufacturing with full wage replacement.

signals.title: European Parliament and Council Formally Adopt Platform Work Directive Directive EU 2024/1890
signals.source_name: European Parliament & Council of the European Union
signals.summary: The EU established a legal presumption of employment for 5.5 million misclassified gig platform workers and enacted the world's first binding ban on automated dismissals by algorithms without human review.
signals.why_it_matters: Establishes statutory employee status and bans automated algorithmic firing of gig workers.

signals.title: United States Department of Labor DOL Enforces Final Rule on Independent Contractor Classification Under the FLSA
signals.source_name: Wage and Hour Division (US Department of Labor)
signals.summary: The US DOL restored the multi-factor 'economic reality' test under the Fair Labor Standards Act, penalizing app-based delivery and rideshare companies that misclassify full-time workers as contractors.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces the economic reality test to crack down on gig worker misclassification.

signals.title: State of California Supreme Court Upholds Proposition 22 with Critical Statutory Workers' Compensation Protections
signals.source_name: Supreme Court of California (Castellanos v. State)
signals.summary: The California Supreme Court preserved app worker flexibility while strictly upholding statutory guarantees requiring platforms to fund occupational accident insurance and minimum wage floors.
signals.why_it_matters: Guarantees statutory healthcare subsidies and minimum wage floors for California app workers.

signals.title: Supreme Court of Spain Tribunal Supremo Enforces Rider Law Ley Rider 12/2021 Algorithm Transparency Ruling
signals.source_name: Supreme Court of Spain (Sala de lo Social)
signals.summary: The Spanish Supreme Court ruled that digital delivery platforms must disclose the exact algorithmic parameters, ratings weights, and task assignment logic to worker union committees.
signals.why_it_matters: Forces gig delivery apps to fully disclose algorithmic dispatch formulas to trade unions.

signals.title: Fair Work Commission Australia Enforces Closing Loopholes No 2 Act Regulating Regulated Gig Platform Work
signals.summary: Australia established statutory powers for the Fair Work Commission to set binding minimum rates of pay, deactivation dispute protections, and superannuation rights for gig delivery riders.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces binding statutory minimum pay rates and unfair dismissal protections for gig workers.

signals.title: International Transport Workers' Federation ITF and International Trade Union Confederation ITUC Launch Global Platform Workers Charter
signals.source_name: ITF & ITUC (Geneva / Global Trade Union Movement)
signals.summary: Global labor federations representing 200 million workers demanded that UN member states enact algorithmic transparency, universal accident insurance, and collective bargaining rights for app workers.
signals.why_it_matters: Unites global transport unions demanding universal collective bargaining for app workers.

signals.title: United Nations Secretary-General and WMO Advance Early Warnings for All EW4All Initiative
signals.summary: The UN deployed $3.1 billion to install advanced Doppler weather radar, AI storm surge forecasting, and cell-broadcast networks across 30 SIDS and LDC frontline nations to achieve 100% early warning coverage.
signals.why_it_matters: Deploys $3.1 billion to achieve universal early warning systems across 30 climate-vulnerable states.

signals.title: European Commission Directorate-General for Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid ECHO Expands EU-Alert Cell Broadcast
signals.source_name: DG ECHO & National Civil Protection Authorities (EU)
signals.summary: The EU achieved full member state integration of geo-located cell-broadcast alerts, pushing real-time evacuation sirens and multi-lingual flash flood maps directly to mobile handsets within 5 seconds.
signals.why_it_matters: Pushes geo-located multilingual flash flood alerts to all mobile phones within 5 seconds.

signals.title: Federal Emergency Management Agency FEMA Expands Wireless Emergency Alerts WEA with Multi-Language AI Broadcasts
signals.summary: FEMA updated the Integrated Public Alert and Warning System (IPAWS) with sub-mile polygon geo-targeting and automated Spanish, Navajo, and Vietnamese emergency translation during wildfires and hurricanes.
signals.why_it_matters: Enforces sub-mile geo-targeted emergency alert broadcasts translated into indigenous languages.

signals.title: Japan Meteorological Agency JMA Deploys J-Alert Quantum Radar Flash Flood and Landslide Warning Network
signals.source_name: JMA & Fire and Disaster Management Agency (FDMA, Japan)
signals.summary: Japan integrated X-band polarimetric radar and AI soil moisture sensors to broadcast automated 30-minute advance landslide evacuation alerts directly to residents in steep mountainous prefectures.
signals.why_it_matters: Broadcasts automated 30-minute advance AI landslide evacuation sirens in mountain prefectures.

signals.title: National Disaster Management Authority NDMA India Deploys Common Alerting Protocol CAP Across 28 States
signals.source_name: NDMA & Department of Telecommunications (Government of India)
signals.summary: India's SACHET disaster portal transmitted 1 billion geo-targeted SMS and cell-broadcast alerts during cyclones Remal and heatwaves, achieving near-zero casualties in Odisha and Gujarat coastal evacuation zones.
signals.why_it_matters: Transmits 1 billion geo-targeted mobile disaster alerts, eliminating coastal cyclone casualties.

signals.title: National Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Council NDRRMC Philippines Deploys Nationwide Emergency Cell Broadcasts
signals.summary: The Philippines enforced statutory rules requiring telecom telcos (Globe, Smart) to transmit mandatory audio-override siren alerts across islands 6 hours ahead of Super Typhoon landfall.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates free emergency audio-override siren broadcasts 6 hours ahead of typhoon landfall.

signals.title: Parliament of Australia and Parliament of Tuvalu Ratify Historic Falepili Union Climate Mobility Treaty
signals.source_name: Commonwealth of Australia & Government of Tuvalu
signals.summary: The landmark Falepili Union entered into full legal force, granting 280 Tuvaluan citizens permanent Australian climate mobility residence visas annually while guaranteeing sovereign maritime zone rights.
signals.why_it_matters: Enacts the world's first bilateral treaty offering climate mobility visas and sovereign rights.

signals.title: New Zealand Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade MFAT Expands Pacific Access Category Climate Resettlement Quotas
signals.summary: New Zealand allocated permanent residence visas to low-lying Pacific islanders from Kiribati, Tuvalu, and Tonga, providing full access to state healthcare, housing, and education upon arrival.
signals.why_it_matters: Provides permanent residence visas and full social welfare for climate-vulnerable Pacific islanders.

signals.title: Government of Fiji Enforces National Climate Relocation Trust Fund and Relocates 40th Coastal Village
signals.source_name: Ministry of Economy & Climate Change Division (Republic of Fiji)
signals.summary: Fiji completed the planned inland relocation of Nabouwalu village under the world's first statutory Climate Relocation Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), constructing solar-powered typhoon-proof homes.
signals.why_it_matters: Executes the world's first statutory planned inland relocation of rising sea-level villages.

signals.title: State of Louisiana Coastal Protection and Restoration Authority CPRA Completes Isle de Jean Charles Resettlement
signals.summary: Louisiana finalized the federal managed retreat and relocation of the tribal community of Isle de Jean Charles to 'The New Isle' (40 miles inland), preserving tribal cultural coherence away from sinking bayous.
signals.why_it_matters: Completes the first federally funded tribal managed retreat and inland community reconstruction in the US.

signals.title: State of Hawaii Department of Land and Natural Resources DLNR Enforces Managed Coastal Retreat and Sea Wall Bans
signals.summary: Hawaii ordered coastal homeowners on Oahu's North Shore to remove illegal sandbags and retreat eroding luxury homes, establishing statutory buyouts to restore public beach access.
signals.why_it_matters: Orders coastal home retreat and bans private sea walls to restore eroding public beaches.

signals.title: Platform on Disaster Displacement PDD and IOM Release Global Report on Human Mobility in a Changing Climate
signals.source_name: Platform on Disaster Displacement & International Organization for Migration (Geneva)
signals.summary: The PDD urged regional economic communities (ECOWAS, SADC, CARICOM) to expand existing free-movement protocols to grant automatic humanitarian residence to climate-displaced citizens.
signals.why_it_matters: Urges regional trade blocs to grant automatic free-movement visas to climate-displaced persons.

signals.title: United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change UNFCCC Board of the Loss and Damage Fund Convenes in Abu Dhabi
signals.source_name: UNFCCC Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage (Abu Dhabi, UAE)
signals.summary: The Board finalized operational guidelines for the historic Loss and Damage Fund, securing initial capital pledges of $800 million to disburse emergency rapid grants directly to climate-devastated frontline states.
signals.why_it_matters: Operationalizes the historic UN Loss and Damage Fund with initial $800 million grant capitalization.

signals.title: Caribbean Catastrophe Risk Insurance Facility CCRIF SPC Disburses Record $30 Million Following Hurricane Beryl
signals.source_name: CCRIF SPC (Grand Cayman / Caribbean Member Governments)
signals.summary: CCRIF triggered automatic parametric payouts to Grenada, Saint Vincent, and Jamaica within 14 days of Hurricane Beryl landfall, providing instant liquidity for emergency port, hospital, and grid repairs.
signals.why_it_matters: Disburses $30 million in instant parametric payouts within 14 days of hurricane landfall.

signals.title: African Risk Capacity ARC Group Pays $20 Million Parametric Drought Payout to Malawi, Zambia and Mozambique
signals.source_name: African Risk Capacity (African Union Specialized Agency, Johannesburg)
signals.summary: ARC triggered satellite NDVI-indexed insurance payouts to drought-stricken Southern African governments, funding emergency food transfers and drought-resistant seeds for 2 million smallholders.
signals.why_it_matters: Triggers $20 million in satellite-indexed parametric drought payouts across Southern Africa.

signals.title: Pacific Catastrophe Risk Insurance Company PCRIC Pays Instant Flood Payout to Vanuatu Following Cyclones
signals.summary: PCRIC executed instant direct bank transfers to the Vanuatu Ministry of Finance under its parametric tropical cyclone policy, restoring communication towers and medical clinic power.
signals.why_it_matters: Executes instant direct treasury transfers under sovereign parametric tropical cyclone insurance.

signals.title: World Bank Issues Record $1.5 Billion in Sovereign Catastrophe Bonds for Mexico, Jamaica and SIDS
signals.source_name: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (World Bank Treasury, Washington DC)
signals.summary: The World Bank issued a portfolio of IBRD Capital-at-Risk catastrophe bonds covering storm and earthquake risks, providing multi-year parametric emergency relief capital.
signals.why_it_matters: Issues $1.5 billion in sovereign catastrophe bonds providing instant disaster liquidity.

signals.title: Federal Communications Commission FCC Enforces 5-Year Deorbit Rule and Fines Satellite Operators for Space Debris
signals.summary: The FCC strictly enforced its rule requiring LEO satellite operators to deorbit spacecraft within 5 years post-mission (down from 25 years) and levied historic fines on un-deorbited geostationary satellites.
signals.why_it_matters: Levies historic fines and enforces a 5-year post-mission satellite deorbit mandate.

signals.title: European Commission Prepares First-Ever EU Space Law to Ensure Sustainable Orbital Operations and Traffic Management
signals.source_name: European Commission (DG DEFIS / Commissioner Thierry Breton)
signals.summary: The EU drafted the EU Space Law establishing mandatory collision avoidance maneuvers, orbital debris mitigation certificates, and carbon footprint tracking for all launch vehicles.
signals.why_it_matters: Drafts the world's first continental space law mandating orbital debris certificates and collision avoidance.

signals.title: Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency JAXA and Astroscale Complete ADRAS-J Active Space Debris Inspection Mission
signals.summary: The commercial debris inspection spacecraft successfully performed proximity operations within meters of an abandoned Japanese rocket upper stage, demonstrating rendezvous tech for active space debris removal.
signals.why_it_matters: Demonstrates sub-meter rendezvous navigation with abandoned orbital space debris.

signals.title: UK Space Agency and ClearSpace Advance ClearSpace-1 Active Debris Removal Mission Launch Preparations
signals.source_name: UK Space Agency & European Space Agency (ESA)
signals.summary: The UK funded robotic capture systems for the ClearSpace-1 mission, designed to capture a 112 kg Vespa upper stage in low Earth orbit using a four-armed robotic gripper and guide it into safe atmospheric burnup.
signals.why_it_matters: Funds four-armed robotic capture spacecraft to deorbit legacy orbital space debris.

signals.title: French Space Agency CNES Enforces Space Operations Act LOS Regulations on Controlled Orbital Re-Entry
signals.summary: CNES mandated that Ariane 6 upper stages (Vinci engine) must execute controlled deorbit burns targeting remote South Pacific ocean areas (Point Nemo) with zero casualty risk on Earth.
signals.why_it_matters: Mandates controlled deorbit burns directing spent rocket stages to the Point Nemo ocean cemetery.

signals.title: Inter-Agency Space Debris Coordination Committee IADC Updates Global Debris Mitigation Guidelines
signals.source_name: IADC (NASA, ESA, JAXA, ISRO, CNSA, CNES, DLR, UKSA)
signals.summary: Thirteen space agencies adopted updated international standards for passivation, propellant venting, and casualty risk modeling (<1:10,000) for all orbital space hardware.
signals.why_it_matters: Harmonizes global engineering standards for propellant venting and space debris passivation.

signals.title: Artemis Accords Cross 40 Signatory State Threshold with Greece, Uruguay, Sweden and Slovenia Acceding
signals.source_name: NASA & US Department of State (Washington DC)
signals.summary: Over 40 sovereign nations acceded to the Artemis Accords, establishing non-binding multilateral principles for transparent lunar exploration, interoperability, emergency assistance, and scientific data sharing.
signals.why_it_matters: Unites 40 sovereign nations under principles of peaceful, transparent lunar exploration.

signals.title: United Nations Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space COPUOS Legal Subcommittee Convenes Working Group on Space Resources
signals.source_name: UN Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA / COPUOS, Vienna)
signals.summary: COPUOS progressed multilateral negotiations on governing in-situ resource utilization (ISRU) on the Moon and celestial bodies, reconciling the 1967 Outer Space Treaty and 1979 Moon Agreement.
signals.why_it_matters: Leads UN multilateral negotiations on governing lunar and asteroid resource extraction.

signals.title: White House Office of Science and Technology Policy OSTP Releases Coordinated Lunar Time Standard Policy LTC
signals.source_name: OSTP (Executive Office of the President of the United States)
